name: Due Task Manager
description: Keyboard-first to-do app with projects, focus sprints, and file attachments. Teaches the database, storage, and Dailey Core auth primitives.

DAILEY_APP_ID.label: Dailey Core client id (your project slug, from auth enable)

notes: Enable Dailey Core auth for the project (dailey_auth_enable), then set DAILEY_APP_ID to the returned client id. Users sign in with their Dailey account.
